You see an ultimate health potion.
It weighs 3.10 oz.
This potion can only be consumed by knights of level 130 or higher.

  • Aaaah...

Notes

It has a deposit of 5 gp and restores between 650 and 850 Hit Points, around 750 on average.
See also: Money Spent per Hit Point and Capacity Taken per Hit Point

History

  • The price was increased from 310 gp to 379 gp, additionally the Store prices were also raised with the update on October 29, 2018 shown below.
    • 100x Ultimate Health Potions went from 23 Tibia Coins to 29 Tibia Coins.
    • 250x Ultimate Health Potions went from 55 Tibia Coins to 68 Tibia Coins.
